findings.detail: Same problem as M3-S24-T1. Both questions are set in a support billing dispute in which a delegated subagent's lookup_order calls time out persistently after retries. In both, the correct answer is to return the already retrieved partial results to the coordinator together with the retry attempts made, so the same reasoning leads to the answer. The setting is also nearly identical. In addition, wrong option A (reporting the timed-out lookup as no matching orders) repeats that question's wrong option. Wrong option D (escalating via escalate_to_human) closely echoes another of its wrong options.

blind_answer.reason: Structured error context should include partial results (the customer record) and what was attempted (three timed-out retries). With both, the coordinator can recover intelligently instead of rerunning the whole verification. A suppresses the error as an empty result, B retries without limit, and D mislabels a transient error as a permission error.
